crossRefs.note: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;
“But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be…
know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be…
They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.
They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a…
Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among…
You shall consume all the peoples whom Yahweh your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall…
Now king Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites…
They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

translations.web: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’ ”
translations.bsb: So now I tell you that I will not drive out these people before you; they will be thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.”
translations.kjv: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare
translations.asv: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
